authority: ROOT ONE historical query only, exact UTC window and exact node(17408) token; no retries or broadening
args: (process == "kernel" OR process == "sandboxd" OR subsystem == "com.apple.sandbox.reporting") AND (eventMessage MATCHES[c] "(?s).*(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])(deny|denied|denial)([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$).*") AND (eventMessage MATCHES "(?s).*(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])node[(]17408[)]([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$).*")
identityBranch: Exact bounded node(17408) message-token branch of ROOT PID-or-token authorization. Does not retrieve PID-only records lacking that token; no undocumented predicate PID key guessed.
rawPolicy: Raw bounded stdout/stderr retained0600 only in owned capture; hash/byte counts published, never full log rows. Local selection keeps only authorized matching timestamp/process/pid/denialOperation/deniedPath/result.

manual.basis: show JSON array; start/end accept explicit numeric UTC offset; timezone is display timezone; NSPredicate process/subsystem/eventMessage keys documented locally

stop: Nonzero/timeout/cap/capture/identity/unknown retirement/empty/unsupported: retain result, no alternate predicate or retry. No native target or profile launch.
